<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide } from "vue"
import {
  AutocompleteRoot,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type AutocompleteRootEmits,
  type AutocompleteRootProps,
} from "reka-ui"

import { autocompleteItemsKey } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<
  AutocompleteRootProps & {
    /** Options to suggest. AutocompleteList renders its slot once per item and filters them as you type. */
    items?: readonly string[]
  }
>()
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteRootEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { items: _items, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegated, emits)

provide(
  autocompleteItemsKey,
  computed(() => props.items),
)
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteRoot v-slot="slotProps" data-slot="autocomplete" v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </AutocompleteRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import {
  AutocompleteContent,
  AutocompletePortal,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type AutocompleteContentEmits,
  type AutocompleteContentProps,
} from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { popupClassName } from "@/components/ui/styles"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AutocompleteContentProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  position: "popper",
  sideOffset: 4,
})
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteContentEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegated, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompletePortal>
    <AutocompleteContent
      data-slot="autocomplete-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="
        cn(
          popupClassName,
          'isolate z-50 flex max-h-(--reka-popper-available-height) w-(--reka-popper-anchor-width) min-w-36 flex-col overflow-hidden p-1',
          props.class,
        )
      "
    >
      <slot />
    </AutocompleteContent>
  </AutocompletePortal>
</template>

files.name: autocomplete/AutocompleteList.vue
files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { AutocompleteViewport, useForwardProps, type AutocompleteViewportProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { autocompleteItemsKey } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteViewportProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()

defineSlots<{
  /** With `items` on Autocomplete, called once per item (`v-slot="{ item }"`); otherwise plain content. */
  default?: (props: { item: string; index: number }) => unknown
}>()

const items = inject(autocompleteItemsKey, undefined)

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegated)
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteViewport
    data-slot="autocomplete-list"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('min-h-0 flex-1 scroll-fade overflow-y-auto', props.class)"
  >
    <template v-if="items">
      <template v-for="(item, index) in items" :key="item">
        <slot :item="item" :index="index" />
      </template>
    </template>
    <slot v-else :item="''" :index="-1" />
  </AutocompleteViewport>
</template>
